intro.text: You know the home row and the top row now – that’s most of the alphabet! Let’s practise real words that use both rows.
intro.tip: Glance at the screen, not your fingers. If you make a slip, keep going calmly.

steps.title: Up and back
steps.instructions: Words that hop between the home row and the top row.

steps.title: Left side reach
steps.instructions: Words that use the left-hand top row keys.

steps.title: Any words at all
steps.instructions: Every word you can type so far.

steps.title: Hands-on challenge
text: people are always ready to help; a quiet ship sails out to sea; it is your day to type a short story;
the old yard is full of flowers; we hope to go to the tower; your kite flies right up high;
